title: Private Pub Crawl with a Local
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience NYC Like a Local—With a Twist of History and Humor
Join me for a one-of-a-kind private pub crawl through New York City’s hidden speakeasies and legendary neighborhoods. I’m an ex stand-up comedian and long-time New Yorker (15+ years), and I’ll be your local guide, drinking buddy, and storyteller for the night. This isn’t your average tour—it’s a laid-back, laughter-filled night out where we hop from bar to bar. No big groups, no boring scripts—just good vibes, secret spots, and unforgettable stories. Book it if you're ready to drink like a local ;)
* contact before booking - must be 21+
